description: r.side's two tasks sleep 50 and 100 and then trace; nothing is runnable at the 110 entry, so the driver cancels the unrelated t.m (r.main) there (its sleep is not a cancellation point: the cancel only makes it runnable), and the following entry's idle run takes a step, which fires both due timers: t.a and t.b complete ok. The driver finishes r.side with an ok body at 150, with nothing left in it, so it closes at once. Its close outcome, read after the close at 160 (the driver observation, step 3, answered from the recently-closed table), is the join of the outcomes of the tasks that completed in it: Ok.
